# Create Linked Services for source systems, ADLS/Blob, Key Vault, REST APIs, databases etc. (`playbook-development-2`)

The prompt will generate a comprehensive set of Azure Linked Service designs for multiple data sources. For each service, it will include detailed descriptions, purpose, authentication methods, security considerations, network requirements, and connectivity constraints. It will also provide parameterized configuration templates (JSON/YAML/ARM/Terraform) with safe example values suitable for dev/test/prod environments. Finally, the document will include a summary table listing linked service names, types, descriptions, templates, and key recommendations or edge cases.

- **Author / Producer**: `harsh.rana@maqsoftware.com`


3. Replace any bracketed placeholders (such as `{Dimension Name}`, `{Source Tables}`, or `{Context}`) with your specific project details.
4. Press Enter to generate SME-ready architecture documents, schemas, or pipelines.

### 2. Verbatim Prompt Template
```markdown
You are an Azure ETL engineer.

Create a comprehensive set of linked service definitions for the following environments and sources:

Data lake storage (ADLS Gen2, Azure Blob Storage, OneLake)
Secrets management (Azure Key Vault)
REST APIs (with authentication)
Relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL)
Cloud-native services (Snowflake, Databricks, Synapse, Fabric, etc.)

**For each linked service, generate:**
•Detailed description of the service
•Purpose
•Security considerations
•Connectivity requirements
•Authentication method
•Network constraints (private endpoints, firewall rules, VNET)
•Configuration Template (JSON / YAML / ARM / Terraform style)

**Include required properties**
•Parameterization for environment variables (dev/test/prod)
•Example values (mocked safely, do NOT include secrets)
•Optional properties with explanation
•Dependency & Ordering Notes

**Final Summary on** 
•Linked Service Name
•Type (ADLS / Blob / REST API / Database / Key Vault)
•Description
•Configuration Template
•Edge Cases & Recommendations
```
